_comment: Copy to summareader-mcp.local.json and fill in. That name is gitignored.
_token: From a paired device: POST /enroll on the sync server, or `summareader-sync pair` for the first one. Revocable.
_master_key: The 32-byte library key, base64 — the same value the pairing QR carries. NOT revocable: anything holding this can read everything, for as long as it holds it.
_name: What this device is called in the app's paired-devices list. Sent once at startup. Without it the server shows whatever label the device that minted the token typed — in practice "A new device".
name: MCP mirror
_bearer_token: Required to call the MCP HTTP port. Without it the port is open to anyone who can reach it and serves the whole library in plaintext; the server warns at startup. Any long random string: openssl rand -base64 32. Called http_token before; that spelling is still read.
_fetch_bodies: Download each article's text as well as its summary, so search covers what the articles say rather than only their titles. A server can afford the bytes; set false if this one cannot.
